notes.title: WinterFest 2024 Update
notes.notes:
🎄 ❄️ Winter Fest is Finally Here! 🎄 ❄️ 
We are thrilled to share with you this year's Christmas update.

Including a new gameplay video, a walk around inside the Osprey, new 3D models, beautiful level designs, amazing animations, sounds, and more. 
We hope these sneak peeks make your day even better.


Thank you for your amazing support and enthusiasm for this project. It motivates us to keep pushing forward.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41687119/38b5506ec117d93049b36350a56361a375385dc4.png

We are incredibly excited for 2025 and hope you are too.
Merry Christmas and Happy Winter Fest! 

Check the Full update here: https://www.moddb.com/mods/operation-black-mesa/articles
